## Summary

Adds generic parser support for Essence Burn's shared color/type target alternatives and selected-target death-to-exile rider, and preserves resolution-created replacements across characteristic changes until their existing expiry or zone-change boundary.

**Draft checkpoint requested by the contributor in their own fork.** Head: `3f970dbcf01138de751de77aa5d26462637cd3e7`. The implementation's current native checks passed, but the required fresh independent implementation review and final upstream handoff are still incomplete. This draft preserves the work for inspection; it is not an upstream acceptance or a ready-for-review claim.

Original run `fra-stingerquill` is preserved with its phase-fit, plans, findings, counters, predictions, checkpoints and all historical FAIL outcomes. This draft publication does not restart the run or retire its open findings. It contains product commits and canonical generated artifacts; temporary proof workflows are excluded.

## Verification

- [ ] Gate A output below is for the current committed head.
- [ ] Final review-impl below is clean for the current committed head.
- [x] Both anchors cite existing analogous code at the same seam.

Current-head native evidence: [V21, successful Stage 1 jobs](https://github.com/keloide/phase/actions/runs/38452331912), immutable product head `3f970dbcf01138de751de77aa5d26462637cd3e7`, phase comparison base `ab1363d1f30141c118db0c83de0da617e0c07c65`, proof workflow SHA `43611d13fadc602653072de05ed273c2689763f6`.

- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` — PASS with default workspace features.
- Full workspace tests — PASS; engine library 23,172 passed / 0 failed / 8 ignored; integration 9,356 passed / 0 failed / 4 ignored.
- Feature-complete focused runtime verification — 5,045 passed / 0 failed; 27 Essence Burn tests, 7 Torch the Tower tests, all 20 retained reference cases, the three issue-735 cases and the IR/lowered snapshot tests passed.
- `./scripts/check-interaction-bindings.sh --check`, parser combinator/prelowered checks, skill-document validation and engine-authority checks — PASS in the Stage 1 completion job.
- Complete pinned-input card export, validator, coverage and semantic audits — PASS; 35,880 faces, zero engine or coverage-honesty regressions and zero new semantic findings.
- Five established production-reversal controls — each failed at its required assertion; all 14 identical restored-candidate controls passed. The deliberately masking live-scalar control is reported as masking, not as a discriminator.
- `python3 scripts/gen-test-fixture.py --check` — PASS; 4,964 complete canonical card values, matching the committed generated fixture.

The first three unchecked boxes are intentional: the final post-synchronization checks, final read-only review and post-review Gate A have not been completed. Successful checkpoint evidence does not satisfy those remaining gates.

## Gate A

Pending final read-only review and its subsequent exact-head Gate A. The current-head Stage 1 parser check passed against the phase base; no final upstream Gate A PASS is claimed.

## Anchored on

- `crates/engine/src/game/game_object.rs:4152` — existing `reseed_replacements_carrying_resolution_effects` composes an incoming intrinsic baseline with the same object's ordered live resolution replacements.

## Final review-impl

Pending at `3f970dbcf01138de751de77aa5d26462637cd3e7`. Two mandatory fresh-review dispatches returned “Selected model is at capacity” before performing any review. No clean-review PASS is claimed; the original lifetime and primary-discrimination findings await the full review's formal adjudication.

## Claimed parse impact

Two measured historical spans are available; a fresh measurement against a synchronized PR target is still pending.

- Original run base → accepted parser phase: Change the Equation; Crypt Angel; Dreams of the Dead; Essence Burn; Greater Realm of Preservation; Mindsparker; Mindwrack Liege; Offspring's Revenge; Penance; Wallop; Wort, the Raidmother. Eleven names / twelve modified signatures; Essence Burn becomes supported with zero gaps.
- Accepted parser phase `ab1363d1f30141c118db0c83de0da617e0c07c65` → this exact head: Ent's Fury; Savage Swipe; Welcome to the Fold. Three stable conditional-scope changes from `CostPaidObject` to `Target`, independently audited over all four complete crosspairs and both same-side repeats. Support remains 32,001/35,880; no Oracle or face additions/removals, zero regressions and zero new semantic findings. Welcome to the Fold's unrelated unsupported madness override remains unsupported.

These separate measurements are not presented as a new comparator run against fork main.

## Scope Expansion

Rules-correct support depends on generic bounded-replacement lifetime preservation across face-down/up, transform, flip, rehydration and copy-recipient characteristic rewrites, without copying external grants into printed/copiable baselines.

The dependent work also corrects generic target authority/reset paths and own-object power/toughness suffix binding, with corresponding ordinary damage, combat and reference tests. The existing Ent's Fury assertion now derives the correct counter-plus-pump result from its full Oracle text; the Tribute reference bodies remain unchanged. Plans and their independent reviews admitted these dependencies in the same original run.

## Validation Failures

- Required full fresh phase-2 implementation review is unavailable because both selected Frontier review models returned a capacity error before substantive work.
- Phase-2 acceptance, cross-phase integration review, once-only upstream synchronization, merged-source canonical generation, final current-head checks/measurement, full final implementation review and independent cross-check remain pending.
- This branch is 16 commits ahead and 73 behind fork main at draft creation. GitHub's comparison merge base is `ec27a8d1a09b3f3e0c0ded9a08b8e6c0aef190ff`; no merge, rebase or final upstream synchronization was performed to publish this checkpoint.
- Preserve all outstanding findings and historical failed predictions. This draft must remain unmerged and draft until the required acceptance work is complete.

## CI Failures

[V21](https://github.com/keloide/phase/actions/runs/38452331912) is terminal FAILURE overall despite all current-head Stage 1 product checks passing: its publication wait expired before the remaining acceptance/handoff prerequisites were published. Merged-source generation and final-head native stages were skipped; dependent transports lacked outputs. This outcome remains FAIL and is not relabeled as a green full workflow.


## Continuation handoff

[Download the complete handoff branch snapshot ZIP (~2.06 GB)](https://github.com/keloide/phase/archive/64a65d7d83a305b1924e40c826a54b7fd2cccdb5.zip) · [Short handoff and restore instructions](https://github.com/keloide/phase/blob/64a65d7d83a305b1924e40c826a54b7fd2cccdb5/README.md) · [Full handoff](https://github.com/keloide/phase/blob/64a65d7d83a305b1924e40c826a54b7fd2cccdb5/HANDOFF.md) · [Checksums](https://github.com/keloide/phase/blob/64a65d7d83a305b1924e40c826a54b7fd2cccdb5/SHA256SUMS)

Published separately on `handoff/fra-stingerquill-2026-10-14`, commit `64a65d7d83a305b1924e40c826a54b7fd2cccdb5`. The implementation branch, PR head and original run files are unchanged.

- **Current phase:** phase 2 implemented at `3f970dbcf01138de751de77aa5d26462637cd3e7`, not accepted. Phase 1 accepted at `ab1363d1f30141c118db0c83de0da617e0c07c65`; original run BASE `ec27a8d1a09b3f3e0c0ded9a08b8e6c0aef190ff`. No final frozen upstream BASE exists.
- **Preserved history:** complete original run directory, append-only phase-fit entries 1–580, budget `until-clean`, plan13 / implementation19 / remote22FORK22ALL, all expansion cases, findings and failed predictions. No reset or reclassification. The current NON-verification failed-prediction streak remains 2.
- **Included evidence:** 30,402 preserved paths plus handoff/index metadata, all locally retained remote-verification archives, raw logs, full exports, policy readings, source snapshots and a source/proof Git bundle. The original directory and every packaged payload were verified byte-for-byte; original history SHA256 `5b4b05b70400e91f87a0393c1ff364113d2c8880c65de8531f9c1d983d2e2de7`.
- **Outstanding findings:** original MED1 lifetime and MED2 primary-discrimination findings await formal retirement. Current C19 Stage 1 native checks are green, including all 27 Essence tests and full Step 5; both latest mandatory fresh reviewers failed at model capacity. Whole V21 remains FAIL due its publication-wait expiry.
- **Next required step:** restore and verify the original history, read CURRENT instructions, obtain concrete reviewer availability and explicit authorization resolving the existing two-failed-NON-predictions stop, then run one WHOLE C8→C19 phase-2 implementation review. Integration, final synchronization/generation/current-head checks/reviews and Gate A/B/scope remain pending.
- **External dependency:** the complete pinned-input ZIP (run37483983597/artifact11424046878) could not be downloaded because its Azure redirect was denied by the enforced proxy. Its exact link/hash/size and **2026-10-20 expiry** are preserved in the archive's `remote-artifacts.json`. Obtain it in an authorized environment before expiry; local AtomicCards/sidecars do not substitute for the full pin.

The downloadable ZIP contains 23 ordered archive parts, each below GitHub's file limit. Follow README to concatenate and extract them. Combined TAR.GZ SHA256: `afe38f947f001ce21f40c305b9721ff080776adab84bed88048854a969064d88`. No temporary handoff artifact was committed to the implementation branch.
